source_reference: Reference card: Air Fryer Demo; preview slug: air_fryer_demo

camera_behavior: Product-focused commercial framing with a close demonstration view
attention_mechanism: Immediate product utility plus visible motion

source_reference: Reference card: Desk Lamp Transformation; preview slug: desk_lamp_transformation

source_reference: Reference card: Pet Hair Remover Pain Hook; preview slug: pet_hair_remover_pain

attention_mechanism: Recognizable pain point creates an unanswered question

reasoning: Problem-first structure is valuable, but the product must arrive early enough to avoid an unbranded cleaning clip.

source_reference: Reference card: Robot Vacuum Pain Hook; preview slug: robot_vacuum_pain

product_timing: Product enters after the pain cue
